$comment: Derived from the real codebase (src/App.jsx routes, src/layout/Layout.jsx chrome flags, src/components/*.jsx, src/pages/*.jsx), cross-checked against CLONE_SPEC.md. Where the two disagreed, the code won: CLONE_SPEC.md's chrome matrix listed a preloader on /start and /auth, but both pages pass no `preloader` prop and Layout defaults it to false.

meta.source: fourmula-clone — pixel-verified clone of fourmula.ai (React 18 + Vite, react-router-dom)
meta.mirror: Homepage/404 transcribed from a saved copy of the original; legal pages from live fetch. See CLONE_SPEC.md.
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill, from direct source inspection

categories.SHELL: Chrome composed by src/layout/Layout.jsx and toggled per route: preloader, consent banner, header, menu overlay, footer, fixed badge.
categories.HERO: The page-opening block that sets a route's premise.
categories.VALUE: Product explanation — what the tool makes and how it behaves.
categories.PROCESS: Step-through of the product flow from input to finished assets.
categories.CONTENT: The substantive body of an inner route.

shell.preloader.description: Full-viewport entry overlay: a stepped spinner, a counting percentage readout and a stack of preloading images, gated by an `is-loading` class on documentElement and torn down by the site's own GSAP script.
shell.preloader.scope: Present on 2 routes — the homepage and the not-found page. Every other template omits it.

shell.cookie-consent.description: Finsweet-driven consent banner plus a settings modal with per-category toggles. Carries its own accent color, distinct from the brand palette.

shell.header.description: Fixed top bar: brand mark, a burger that drives the menu overlay, a scroll-progress readout, a theme toggle, and sign-in plus get-started actions.
shell.header.scope: Present on all 6 routes; marks the brand link as current only on the homepage.

shell.menu-overlay.description: Collapsed pill that expands into a full navigation panel on burger click, with staggered link reveals and a hand-rolled text scramble on the trigger label. Closed state has zero height, so its links are not hit-testable until opened.
shell.menu-overlay.scope: Present on 5 routes; the not-found template drops it entirely.

shell.footer.description: Closing chrome: brand mark, grouped navigation, legal links, social link and registration detail, plus the interactive dot field that the homepage motion scripts animate.
shell.footer.scope: Present on 5 routes; the not-found template drops it entirely, which is also why that route has no dot field.

shell.awards-badge.description: Fixed vertical badge pinned to the right edge, mounted at body level outside the page wrapper so it is unaffected by page transforms. Its outbound link is deliberately inert.

hero.catalog.description: Homepage opener: the catalog headline with a per-word opacity reveal, a continuously rotating image carousel with counter-rotated frames, a vertical marquee of output types, and a drag-and-drop upload affordance.

hero.not-found.description: Not-found opener: a two-line broken-formula headline, a get-started action, and a looping theme-paired image that swaps with the active theme.

value.capability-statement.description: Short two-part statement block: a small eyebrow label beside a large headline whose words flash in on scroll. Carries no imagery or actions.

value.photoshoot-showcase.description: The heaviest media block: a studio-quality pitch over a grid of product stills and autoplaying background videos with poster fallbacks, honouring reduced-motion and Save-Data, plus its own call to action.

value.how-it-works.description: How-it-works block built from CSS marquees — a horizontally scrolling bottom row and vertically scrolling columns — with a rotating set of claim titles and a single get-started action.

process.four-steps.description: Scroll-driven sequence taking the reader from product input to finished assets, as stacked slides over gradient backdrops with a pinned, perspective-based transition.

support.faq.description: Accordion of product questions, one open at a time, each toggling an `active` class and rotating its indicator.

content.legal-document.description: Legal document body in the inner-page `.tech` shell: an oversized title above a rich-text block of numbered sections, a table-of-contents anchor list, and nested lists. The privacy instance additionally carries a multi-row cookie data table that the terms instance has no equivalent of.
content.legal-document.scope: Carried by the legal template across 2 routes, as two separately authored page-local components rather than one shared body component.

content.start-panel.description: Onboarding entry panel in the `.tech` shell: title, a short explanatory paragraph, and a pair of actions leading to sign-in and back to the site. Composed from this project's own design system — the real target renders client-side only, so nothing was measured for it.

content.auth-panel.description: Sign-in stand-in in the `.tech` shell: title, explanatory paragraph, a single-field form and a return action. The form is deliberately inert — no action, no handler beyond preventDefault, no state and no network — and must not be wired up. Composed, not measured.
